text: 问：9月30日至10月1日，G20贸易部长会议在美国威斯康星州密尔沃基举行。据了解，会议就反对粮食武器化议题达成联合声明，未就应对产能过剩、消除强迫劳动、调整最惠国待遇原则议题形成成果文件。请问中方如何评价本次会议？中方发挥了怎样的作用？ 答：本次G20贸易部长会议，成员围绕主席国美方设置的反对粮食武器化、应对产能过剩、消除强迫劳动、调整最惠国待遇原则等议题交换意见，并就粮食议题达成联合声明，其余议题未形成成果文件。 在粮食议题磋商中，包括中方在内的许多新兴市场和发展中成员都提出，粮食进口国和出口国应当共同维护粮食供应链稳定，同时，各方有权出于国内公共政
text_en: Q: From September 30 to October 1, the G20 Trade Ministers' Meeting was held in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA. It is understood that the meeting reached a joint statement on opposing the weaponization of food, but did not form an outcome document on addressing overcapacity, eliminating forced labor, or adjusting the most-favored-nation principle. How does China evaluate this meeting? What role did China play? A: At this G20 Trade Ministers' Meeting, members exchanged views on topics set by the U.S. presidency, including opposing the weaponization of food, addressing overcapacity, eliminating forced labor, and adjusting the most-favored-nation principle, and reached a joint statement on the food issue, while no outcome document was formed on the other topics.
